title: Author Site Request
description: Authors every page of a site as HTML and CSS. The service derives the slots and the fixed parts from site_ast and content, shows the model the direction prose and the canvases, and has it write each page: the top page first, then a lead sub page chained off it (which fixes the shared parts' CSS), then the remaining pages in parallel, then the first item of each collection; other items are expanded without a model. Every page is judged (browser render at 320px and 1280px, slot usage, links) and regenerated with the findings until it passes or retry_limit is spent. Images are returned as requests, not generated here.

site_id.description: Caller-owned identity carried into the snapshot and used as the Forms Service site key.

retry_limit.description: How many times a failed page may be regenerated with the judge's findings.

page_keys.description: Author only these pages (by key; collection items as <collection>/<id>). The top page is always authored first when it is included, because later pages reuse its fixed-part CSS.
